hypotheses.L1_compact_semantic_readout: Top-4 output-conditioned modes have median next-token AUROC at least 0.60 and remain within 0.05 of the full quadratic form on every corpus.
hypotheses.L2_high_positive_causal_specificity: On high-scoring positive contexts, top-mode edits produce at least twice the absolute class-logit effect of norm-matched low modes on every corpus.
hypotheses.L3_random_positive_causal_specificity: On random positive contexts, top-mode edits produce at least 1.5 times the absolute class-logit effect of low modes on every corpus.
hypotheses.L4_category_consistency: Top-mode effects exceed low-mode effects for at least four of five category medians on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_distribution_transfer: At least four categories have top-4 AUROC above 0.60 on each OOD corpus.
